destinations.name: Kyoto
destinations.description: Experience traditional temples, serene gardens, and beautiful cherry blossoms.

destinations.name: Santorini
destinations.description: Stunning white-washed buildings, blue domes, and breathtaking sunsets over the Aegean Sea.

destinations.name: Machu Picchu
destinations.description: An ancient Incan citadel set high in the Andes Mountains. A hiker's paradise.

destinations.name: Banff National Park
destinations.description: Crystal clear turquoise lakes surrounded by the majestic Rocky Mountains.

destinations.name: Rome
destinations.description: A living museum of ancient history, world-class art, and incredible cuisine.

destinations.name: Maui
destinations.description: Tropical paradise known for its volcanic beaches, waterfalls, and the Road to Hana.

destinations.name: Bora Bora
destinations.description: Luxurious overwater bungalows and a vibrant turquoise lagoon perfect for snorkeling.

destinations.name: Swiss Alps
destinations.description: Dramatic peaks, charming alpine villages, and world-class skiing resorts.

destinations.name: Petra
destinations.description: The famous 'Rose City' carved directly into vibrant red sandstone cliff faces.

destinations.name: Maldives
destinations.description: A tropical nation in the Indian Ocean known for its beaches, blue lagoons, and extensive reefs.

destinations.name: Phuket
destinations.description: Rainforested, mountainous island in the Andaman Sea with some of Thailand’s most popular beaches.

destinations.name: Grand Canyon
destinations.description: One of the world's natural wonders, featuring layered bands of red rock revealing millions of years of geological history.

destinations.name: Cape Town
destinations.description: A port city beneath the sweeping views of Table Mountain, famous for its harbor and beautiful flora.

destinations.name: Reykjavik
destinations.description: The gateway to Iceland's dramatic landscapes of volcanoes, geysers, hot springs and lava fields.

destinations.name: Paris
destinations.description: The global center for art, fashion, gastronomy, and culture, home to the iconic Eiffel Tower.
